North Eastern Regional Load Despatch Centre Dongtieh, Lower Nongrah, Lapalang, Shillong -793006, Meghalaya. _(a) Approve the Detailed Project Report on Renovation & Modernization for Life Extension of the 2x23 MW Khandong Power Station with an estimated project cost of Rs. 248.11 crore; and_ _(b) Allow recovery of the approved O&M expenses and interest on loan during the period of complete/partial shutdown for R&M activities so that these expenditures are not required to be capitalized with the R&M cost._ (a) The Khandong Power Station will be completing its useful life on 3.5.2024. Due to a long operation of 36 years, the operating efficiency of the machines has deteriorated. Generating units have got de-rated, and the condition of their auxiliaries, instruments, protective relays & control equipment has deteriorated to such an extent that the combined output of the power plants has fallen below the nameplate capacity with all units running. The units are now operating at 100% gate opening to achieve 67-68 MW against the rated Installed Capacity of 75 MW at FRL i.e. 725.00M. The units with 100% gate opening are not able to respond to grid codes like Primary Response, RGMO, AGC (Automatic Generation Control), etc. (c) The following problems are being faced at the power station, causing frequent outages of the generating units, which in turn is leading to substantial wastage of available water power potential: - (ii) Deterioration of the underwater parts is a major factor for the inefficient operation of the power plant. (d) CEA guidelines on the “Best Practices & Bench Marking for Hydro” under Chapter 7, Renovation, and Modernisation & Up-rating of hydro power plants stipulate that by undertaking timely RM&U & Life extension program, the generating plant can be made to operate for an extended period of 20-25 years with improved reliability and availability. (e) The Petitioner has prepared a Detailed Project Report (DPR) on Renovation & Modernization for life extension of the Khandong Power Station based on RLA & LE studies for some Electro-mechanical (E&M) and Hydro-Mechanical systems carried out by M/s. CPRI. 3. The Petition was heard on ‘admission’ on 27.4.2021, and the Commission, after considering the submissions of the parties, admitted the petition and directed issue of notice to the Respondents. The Commission, after directing the Petitioner to file certain additional information, permitted the parties to complete their pleadings in the matter. In response to the above directions, the Petitioner has filed additional information, vide affidavit dated 19.5.2021, after serving a copy on the Respondents. None of the Respondents has filed 4. During the hearing of the Petition on 2.7.2025, the representative of the Petitioner made oral submissions in support of the reliefs sought in the petition. However, on a specific query of the Commission with regard to the status of approval of the DPR by the CEA, the representative of the Petitioner clarified that the DPR submitted to CEA for approval on 4.8.2020, is under active consideration by the CEA, and approval is expected shortly. On an observation of the Commission that no purpose would be served to keep the matter pending, considering the fact that the DPR approval by CEA is awaited and that the anticipated COD of the Units (post-R&M) would fall during the period 2024-29, thereby requiring revision of the petition in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, the representative of the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present petition, with liberty to the Petitioner to approach the Commission on this subject, after approval of the DPR. He also prayed for adjustment of the filing fees paid for the present Petition, against the Petition to be filed on the subject, in future. 5. In view of the above submissions, the Petitioner is permitted to ‘withdraw’ the present Petition with the liberty to approach the Commission in the future, with a fresh petition, along with all relevant supporting documents. The filing fees paid in the present Petition will be adjusted against the Petition to be filed in the future, as stated above. |**_Sd/-_**|**_Sd/-_**|**_Sd/-_**|**_Sd/-_**| |---|---|---|---| |**(Ravinder Singh Dhillon)**|**(Harish Dudani)**|**(Ramesh Babu V.)**|**(Jishnu Barua)**| |**Member**|**Member**|**Member**|**Chairperson**|
